name: Mainz-Finthen
notes: ADAC-Flugplatzrennen Mainz-Finthen (2.250 km from 1986): clockwise per Oliver Pohlmann's Commons diagram (File:Mainz-Finthen.svg, no north arrow; orientation matched to OSM): start/finish heading west on the paved runway 07/25, up the west end onto taxiway A, east along A, down taxiway C to the runway's east end. The step/chicane on the north side in the diagram is not on today's taxiway and is not modelled. Traced 2135 m vs 2250 m.
